summary: The domino-building board game comes to life!
description:
Compete to build a mighty kingdom in the official Kingdomino digital board game!

Expand your realm by placing domino-style terrain tiles, collecting valuable crowns and making clever strategic decisions. Every tile shapes your kingdom, every draft presents a new challenge, and every decision brings you closer to victory.

Winner of the prestigious Spiel des Jahres award, Kingdomino combines simple rules with satisfying strategic depth. Whether you're playing your first game or playing competitively for the perfect score, every kingdom is unique.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Challenge players from around the world in online multiplayer
• Create private matches and play with friends
• Sharpen your skills against intelligent AI opponents
• Play together on one device with Pass & Play
• Enjoy full cross-platform gameplay across PC and mobile

BUILD THE PERFECT KINGDOM
Connect forests, lakes, fields and more, watching your kingdom come to life with every turn. Collect crowns to multiply your score and carefully plan each draft, balancing powerful tiles against turn order.

Quick to learn and endlessly rewarding to master, Kingdomino is perfect for casual players, families and strategy fans alike.

UNLOCK NEW REWARDS
• Earn achievements as you play
• Unlock new castles, avatars and other cosmetics
• Discover the mysterious Lost Kingdom

THE COMPLETE KINGDOMINO EXPERIENCE
• Official digital adaptation of the multi-award-winning board game
• Classic 1–4 player turn-based gameplay
• Multiple kingdom sizes, including 5×5 and 7×7 modes
• Age of Giants game variation
• Interactive tutorial
• Premium experience with no pay-to-win mechanics or ads

WHY MILLIONS LOVE KINGDOMINO
Designed by Bruno Cathala and published by Blue Orange, Kingdomino has become a modern classic among tabletop fans worldwide. Its elegant tile-placement gameplay creates meaningful decisions every turn while remaining approachable for players of all ages.

Whether you're competing online, enjoying a relaxing solo game or gathering friends around a single device, Kingdomino delivers a fast, satisfying strategy experience in just 10–20 minutes.

Download Kingdomino today and start building your kingdom.
